query: Ship MD-1820 end-to-end - take it from start to finish.
expected_behavior: Recognizes this as a whole-lifecycle request and acts as the orchestrator, walking the canonical stages in order: ticket lookup -> branch & worktree -> atomic commits -> dev -> PR -> prod -> cleanup
Delegates each stage to its dedicated skill (tron:start-ticket, tron:git-commit, tron:git-dev, tron:git-pr, tron:git-pushtoprod, tron:close-worktree) rather than re-implementing any stage itself
Stays orchestration-only (haiku tier): it sequences and hands off, it does not add its own judgment to the individual moves
Confirms with the user at the promotion gates rather than pushing to dev or prod unattended
